title: 建築構造力学Ⅱ
subtitle: Structural Mechanics for Architecture II
educationalGoal: First, they must understand how to decide whether a structure is statically determinate or indeterminate. In addition, students learn to estimate structural deformation using the principle of virtual work and simple solutions for statically indeterminate structures. We give a lecture on the slope-deflection method and finding solutions using the linear moment distribution method of modeling statically indeterminate structures. Students will be able to solve for design stresses at the end of this class.
advice:
1. Outline and review
2. Deformation of members (elastic curves, Mall's theorem)
3. Deformation of statically determinate structures using the principle of virtual work
4. Solution of primary statically indeterminate structures using the stress method
5. Buckling of compression members
6. Solution of statically indeterminate frames using the deflection angle method
7. Solution of statically indeterminate frames using the fixed moment method
8. Solution of statically indeterminate frames using the slope-deflection method
books: ステップアップ建築構造力学
requiredKnowledge: Students must have credit for Structural Mechanics for Architecture I.

activityGoals.body: Students can calculate structural deformation using the principle of virtual work.
Students can calculate of buckling loads.
Students can calculate stress and deformation of indeterminate frames using the slope-deflection method.
Students can calculate stress and deformation of indeterminate frames using the the moment distribution method.
Students can calculate stress and deformation of indeterminate frames using the D-value method.
